title: Hurricane Harvey Support
description: Members of the Texas National Guard and Joint Base San Antonio prepare to deploy in support of relief and recovery efforts in Houston and other areas impacted by Hurricane Harvey.  Hurricane Harvey caused massive flooding in Southeast Texas.
keywords: Lackland, arnorth, AMC, 63rd Expeditionary Signal Battalion, MH -53, JBSA, 181st Airlift Squadron, 502 ABW, Hurricane Harvey, 63rd Expeditionary Signal Battallion Joint Force, JB Cha, C-17, airlift, C-130, Charleston

transcript.text: - [Voiceover] Adjoint-base, San Antonio Kelly Airfield,
becomes a hub for units and Air Force's members
preparing to provide disaster relief support
for areas of Texas affected by Hurricane Harvey.
^- As Americans, it's our duty, our responsibility,
^to go out and help each other
^and to be able to wear this uniform and do that.
That's an honor for all of us.
So, it's a privilege, an honor, to just be able to do that.
- [Voiceover] As relief missions begin,
the members of the 63rd Expeditionary Signal Battalion
are among the first units to arrive
to the Kelly Air terminal in order to support
Task Force 51 and provide communications
to the responders in the field.
- Task Force 51 has been assigned
the responsible unit preparing logistics
to help us support the relief effort.
^So, the special TVR unit is Expeditionary Signal Platoons,
^and what we do is we go out and support units
^that don't have embedded signal in them,
and what they'll be doing is providing them
internet and phone capabilities
where otherwise they wouldn't have them.
A lot of cell towers have been knocked out.
A lot of power lines have been dropped.
So, we autonomously can provide all of that.
- [Voiceover] The Texas Air National Guard
also made an appearance at Kelly Airfield.
The crew of a C-130 Hercules from the
181st Airlift Squadron, along with members of the
502nd Logistic Readiness Squadron Air Terminal Element,
loaded medical supplies from the
Air Force Medical Operations Activity.
^- Right now, air-medical evacuation AE pallets
^are being prepared for us to take
and hook up with air-medical evacuation teams and crews
so they can have the flight surgeons and the nurses
and the med-techs to have the equipment necessary
to do their jobs and helping the hurricane victims.
- [Voiceover] To complete the joint presence,
four U.S. Navy MH-53, C-Dragons
also landed in the airfield in preparations
for support missions to come.
(dramatic music)
